name: street
label: Subject Property Street
help: Street address with house number, for example 2800 N 24th St.

name: state
label: Subject Property State
help: Two-letter state code, for example AZ.

spec.name: inList
spec.label: Investor Types
spec.help: For example FLIPPER, LANDLORD, CASH BUYER. Replaces the default (FLIPPER and LANDLORD).

spec.name: ownership
spec.label: Ownership
spec.help: Which owners of a comparable property qualify. Default any.

name: additionalCriteria
label: Additional Criteria (JSON)
help: Optional JSON object merged into the search criteria. The fields above win on conflict. Callback URL keys are ignored. Optional JSON object with extra filters, for example {"general":{"propertyTypeCategory":{"equals":"Single Family"}}}. Fields you fill in above take priority.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: The maximum number of investors to return in total (1 to 5000, default 25). They are requested in pages of up to 100, and never more than this number are requested.
